llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only CEO guidance pack that asks for no credentials, installs nothing, and its requirements and instructions align with its stated purpose.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (CEO guidance: strategy, board, finance, operations) match the provided files (strategy.md, finance.md, board.md, etc.). The skill declares no binaries, env vars, or config paths — consistent with a documentation/instruction-only skill.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md and the included documents contain only operational guidance, checklists, and frameworks for executive decisions. They do not instruct the agent to read arbitrary host files, call external endpoints, or access credentials. The human-in-the-loop guidance explicitly escalates high-risk actions to humans, which is appropriate.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files — nothing is written to disk or downloaded. This is the lowest-risk install posture for a skill of this type.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables, credentials, or config paths. There are no secret names or unrelated service tokens present, which is proportionate for a pure guidance skill.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request always:true and has no install footprint. However, platform defaults allow autonomous invocation (disable-model-invocation: false). Although the skill itself is benign, consider whether the agent is permitted elsewhere to take real-world actions (send email, modify tickets, call APIs) using other enabled tools — combine this skill's decision guidance with agent actions could produce impactful outcomes if not human-reviewed.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is essentially a collection of CEO playbooks and is internally consistent and low technical risk: it asks for nothing and installs nothing. Before enabling it widely, decide how much autonomy you want the agent to have: restrict outbound actions (email, API calls, ticketing systems, financial systems) if you do not want the agent to act on its recommendations automatically. Always require human approval for high-stakes items (fundraising terms, executive hires/fires, pivots, public communications) and review any private company data you feed into the skill, since its guidance could echo or reveal sensitive information if used in prompts.
